reason: I build 1-6 custom homes a year and half of them change after the architect hands me plans. I'm not putting something on my website that might show a client a house we won't build. Also the boss decides, and I'm on a job site, not looking at this.
objection: Will it actually match the plans? If it shows a finish or a layout we won't build, I'm the one eating that conversation with the client.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing my own plan done over lunch and it matching to the inch, plus a clear written rule that every walkthrough is labeled as a rendering and revisions are free when the plans change.
